discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed on the current head. Provider API routes now use `toProviderConnectionResponse()` for create, list, detail, and update, and that helper strips `providerSpecificData.sessionToken` for AWS credential-form providers. The stored token remains available server-side; the API regression asserts it is absent from every response.

Fixed in commit 01ef243: added streamController.handleError(...) on the early-return path, and the message now strips HTML tags and clamps length before reflecting into the client error message to avoid XSS via untrusted upstream text.

Valid catch, fixed in a4e8066. A search scoped away from public web access must not be rerouted through an external provider, that would break the scope the client asked for. prepareWebSearchFallbackBody now returns the body untouched with the fallback disabled whenever any built-in web_search tool carries external_web_access:false, so the whole request goes to the upstream as if this feature did not exist. Covered by a new unit test.
